subject: The Luminous Mind framework treats brain health as a whole-system project
script: From Agewell Brief: The Luminous Mind framework treats brain health as a whole-system project. The Luminous Mind guide approaches brain health through several tracks at once: sleep, stress, movement, nutrition, learning, and the program’s own supplement framework. Its strongest editorial idea is that cognition is not a single switch. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
